title: Rainy Venetian Harbor
description: A serene rainy scene depicts a weathered yellow stucco building with an arched balcony overlooking a calm sea. Orange curtains billow in the wind beside a glowing lantern while two sailboats float on the water surrounded by floating flowers and distant rain clouds at dusk.
prompt: A romantic realistic painting of a weathered yellow Mediterranean building with an arched stone balcony overlooking a calm sea at dusk during rainfall. Wet stone surfaces, orange curtains billowing dramatically in the wind, hanging white flowers and vines, glowing lanterns, two wooden sailboats on the water with floating white and yellow flowers, misty rain, soft purple and pink sky, atmospheric and serene mood.
